sources.title: Visit Saudi visa regulations: live country groups
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Visit Saudi country-group dataset is served by the Saudi Tourism Authority official tourism domain and is the current nationality selector used by Visit Saudi visa regulations.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Israel is listed in the current country dataset with visaGroup eligible.

sources.title: Visit Saudi visa regulations: live route configuration
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Visit Saudi route configuration is served by the Saudi Tourism Authority official tourism domain and defines the available visitor routes for each current visa group.
sources.supportingExcerpt: At the airport or entry point, use a kiosk or passport control office to apply for visa on arrival.

policies.title: Israeli ordinary passports: Saudi Arabia visa on arrival
policies.summary: The live Saudi Tourism Authority nationality dataset now classifies Israel as eligible. The current eligible-group route configuration expressly offers visa on arrival, issued at the Saudi airport or entry point; it is the least-burdensome unconditional ordinary-passport visitor route.
conditions: The traveler applies at a Saudi airport or other entry point using the kiosk or passport-control office; this is arrival issuance, not an ETA or a prior eVisa requirement.
The route requires a passport generally valid at least six months; individual entry, security, and immigration-admission decisions remain separate.

The same eligible group also has a pre-travel eVisa option, but its availability does not displace the easier current visa-on-arrival route. This policy does not model package, third-country visa/residence, GCC-resident, diplomatic, special-document, work, Hajj, residence, transit, or other conditional routes.

conflicts.explanation: The live Saudi Tourism Authority country dataset now identifies Israel as eligible. The eligible route configuration expressly provides visa issuance on arrival at a kiosk or passport-control office, so the fallback advance-visa label is incorrect.
